plain: One number saying how much of a given direction a list of numbers contains, found with a dot product.
eli5: How far you have walked in the north direction, even if you walked a bit sideways too.
technical: The scalar h·v̂ of an activation h with a unit vector v̂; interpretability papers read a concept's strength this way, and AUCs, z-scores and steering checks are all built from it.
